description: PR 876 comments 2 and overlapping 4. User explicitly approved generic attachment notice, preservation of original error, removal of raw HTTP/timeout interpretation and moving policy to existing Channels delivery orchestration. Extend Channels.Api deliver_outgoing with private best-effort notice helper; invoke existing bridge.send_reply with empty attachments and callback metadata removed, using same resolved connection; preserve original response and avoid recording notice as successful attachment delivery. Remove JidoChatBridge fallback/classification helpers. Action reuse: reuse existing API event delivery owner, bridge transport callbacks and DeliveryConfirmation; no new Action/framework/tool or duplicated transport. Shared generic fallback applies at API delivery boundary; direct bridge calls only return errors. Contract: any failed attachment-bearing outgoing with binary body receives one conservative notice attempt, no attachment retry; success/text-only/nonbinary body do not trigger fallback. Test behavior approval: user go ahead and apply this follows explicit proposal of generic text and ownership move; migrate affected notice tests to API entry and replace specific text assertions with agreed notice, preserving error/no-retry/body/callback invariants. Add API/bridge regression coverage. No UI changes or new browser journey. Run mix q and focused API/chat/attachment integration tests; final PR coverage/precommit remains zaq-juu.8.

comments.text: Scope corrected and approved by user implement that: introduce ZAQ DeliveryError with reason/message/stage/delivery; bridge-owned mappings, API-owned fallback. Stage preparation or transport; certainty not_sent or unconfirmed. SMTP errors never automatically resend; attachment preparation may send text-only; uncertain Jido may update an existing placeholder but never create a new post. Original reason preserved inside struct, callers/tests matching reasons must use field. Explicit user approval covers these expectation changes and earlier approval covers email preparation fallback after revocation. Retain completed prepare/DecodeBase64 work. Reuse Swoosh gen_smtp known error contract in EmailBridge only; no Jido semantics for email. Existing API upsert callback offers update-only path with present ID; no new transport API.

title: Use generic attachment failure notice in Channels delivery orchestration
